conclusion: InlongSlicer remains an Agents 4.0 dot-layout Consumer. Project-owned AGENTS.override.md incorporates the managed shared rules and routes routine product commits/pushes through Consumer Checkpoint, the guidance audit, relevant product checks and source correspondence. Root CLAUDE.md and the publication command share this project policy. A current explicit push request authorizes that push without another Provider-gate confirmation; commit-only requests and historical approvals do not authorize new pushes. Routine publication does not require RequireReleaseReady, a Provider exception or a separate Provider evidence commit. Actual Agents distribution releases retain their Provider gate. Fresh remote observation, non-force pushes and verified remote HEAD remain required. All 29 managed assets and the manifest are unchanged. Reviewed durable knowledge remains immutable v4 JSON; native hooks and global settings were not changed.
